title: Grusch's witness and the 300 ft triangle over a car

tellings.quote: but he mentioned a huge 300 ft triangle that somebody uh saw on their way to work.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels passes on something he heard from David Grusch, a man who has spoken out about secret UFO programmes. According to Michels, Grusch mentioned a witness who, sometime in the 2010s near Norfolk, Virginia, saw a huge triangle-shaped object, about 300 feet across, on the way to work. If true, it would mean an enormous unexplained craft was seen over an ordinary commute.
